## Validation using correlation
```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Import primary risk scores
tbd_risk <- read_csv("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Vector-level risk/Vector_level_risk_scaled.csv")

# Import TBD incidence data
tbd_inc <- read_csv("C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/TBD cases/TBD_annual_average_incidence_scaled_vector.csv")

# Standardize county names and merge
validation_df <- tbd_risk %>%
  mutate(County = County |> stringr::str_to_lower() |>
           stringr::str_replace_all(" ", "")) %>%
  inner_join(
    tbd_inc %>%
      mutate(County = County |> stringr::str_to_lower() |>
               stringr::str_replace_all(" ", "")),
    by = "County"
  )

# Check merge
cat("Counties in validation dataset:", nrow(validation_df), "\n")

# Spearman correlation tests
cat("\n--- A. americanum ---\n")
cor_aa <- cor.test(validation_df$Risk_aa_scaled,
                   validation_df$Inc_aa_cases,
                   method = "spearman")
print(cor_aa)

cat("\n--- D. variabilis ---\n")
cor_dv <- cor.test(validation_df$Risk_dv_scaled,
                   validation_df$Inc_dv_cases,
                   method = "spearman")
print(cor_dv)

cat("\n--- I. scapularis ---\n")
cor_is <- cor.test(validation_df$Risk_is_scaled,
                   validation_df$Inc_is_cases,
                   method = "spearman")
print(cor_is)

# Summary table
cor_summary <- data.frame(
  Species    = c("A. americanum", "D. variabilis", "I. scapularis"),
  Spearman_r = round(c(cor_aa$estimate,
                        cor_dv$estimate,
                        cor_is$estimate), 3),
  P_value    = round(c(cor_aa$p.value,
                        cor_dv$p.value,
                        cor_is$p.value), 4)
)
print(cor_summary)

# Scatter plots
out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Output"

plot_val <- function(data, risk_col, inc_col, species_label) {

  r_val <- round(cor(data[[risk_col]], data[[inc_col]],
                     method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), 3)
  p_val <- cor.test(data[[risk_col]], data[[inc_col]],
                    method = "spearman")$p.value
  p_label <- ifelse(p_val < 0.001, "p < 0.001",
                    paste0("p = ", round(p_val, 3)))

  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[risk_col]], y = .data[[inc_col]])) +
    geom_point(aes(color = .data[[risk_col]]),
               size = 2.5, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE,
                color     = "#3B3B98",
                fill      = "#A8A8D8",
                alpha     = 0.3,
                linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_color_gradient(low  = "grey30",
                         high = "#E84646",
                         name = "Risk score",
                         limits = c(0, 1)) +
    annotate("text",
             x        = 0.05,
             y        = max(data[[inc_col]], na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95,
             label    = paste0("r[s] == ", r_val, "~~", p_label),
             parse    = TRUE,
             size     = 3.5,
             hjust    = 0,
             color    = "black",
             fontface = "bold") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    labs(title = bquote(italic(.(species_label))),
         x     = "Risk score",
         y     = "Annual average incidence\n(per 100,000)") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      plot.title   = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11, face = "italic"),
      axis.text    = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
      axis.title   = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.text  = element_text(size = 7)
    )
}

p1 <- plot_val(validation_df, "Risk_aa_scaled",
               "Inc_aa_cases", "Amblyomma americanum")
p2 <- plot_val(validation_df, "Risk_dv_scaled",
               "Inc_dv_cases", "Dermacentor variabilis")
p3 <- plot_val(validation_df, "Risk_is_scaled",
               "Inc_is_cases", "Ixodes scapularis")

val_panel <- p1 + p2 + p3 +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3, guides = "collect") &
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(val_panel)


ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "validation_spearman_correlation.tiff"),
       val_panel, width = 14, height = 5.5, dpi = 300,
       compression = "lzw")

message("Saved: validation_spearman_correlation.png/.tiff")

```



## Validtaion using negative binomial regression
```{r}
library(MASS)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Import primary risk scores
tbd_risk <- read_csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Vector-level risk/Vector_level_risk_scaled.csv"
)

# Import TBD incidence data
tbd_inc <- read_csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/TBD cases/TBD_annual_average_incidence_scaled_vector.csv"
)

# Standardize county names and merge
validation_df <- tbd_risk %>%
  mutate(County = tolower(stringr::str_replace_all(County, " ", ""))) %>%
  inner_join(
    tbd_inc %>%
      mutate(County = tolower(stringr::str_replace_all(County, " ", ""))),
    by = "County"
  )

cat("Counties in validation dataset:", nrow(validation_df), "\n")

# Ixodes scapularis NB regression
# Outcome: is_tbd_cases, predictor: Risk_is_scaled, offset: log(population)
m_nb_is <- glm.nb(is_tbd_cases ~ Risk_is_scaled + offset(log(population)),
                  data = validation_df,
                  init.theta = 0.5, maxit = 100)

summary(m_nb_is)
cat("\nIS IRR:", exp(coef(m_nb_is)["Risk_is_scaled"]), "\n")
cat("IS 95% CI IRR:", exp(confint(m_nb_is)["Risk_is_scaled", ]), "\n")

# Dermacentor variabilis NB regression
# Outcome: dv_tbd_cases, predictor: Risk_dv_scaled, offset: log(population)
m_nb_dv <- glm.nb(dv_tbd_cases ~ Risk_dv_scaled + offset(log(population)),
                  data = validation_df,
                  init.theta = 0.5, maxit = 100)

summary(m_nb_dv)
cat("\nDV IRR:", exp(coef(m_nb_dv)["Risk_dv_scaled"]), "\n")
cat("DV 95% CI IRR:", exp(confint(m_nb_dv)["Risk_dv_scaled", ]), "\n")

# Amblyomma americanum NB regression
# Outcome: aa_tbd_cases, predictor: Risk_aa_scaled, offset: log(population)
m_nb_aa <- glm.nb(aa_tbd_cases ~ Risk_aa_scaled + offset(log(population)),
                  data = validation_df,
                  init.theta = 0.5, maxit = 100)

summary(m_nb_aa)
cat("\nAA IRR:", exp(coef(m_nb_aa)["Risk_aa_scaled"]), "\n")
cat("AA 95% CI IRR:", exp(confint(m_nb_aa)["Risk_aa_scaled", ]), "\n")
```

## Plotting Negative Binomial Results
```{r}
library(MASS)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Import primary risk scores
tbd_risk <- read_csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Vector-level risk/Vector_level_risk_scaled.csv"
)

# Import TBD incidence data
tbd_inc <- read_csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/TBD cases/TBD_annual_average_incidence_scaled_vector.csv"
)

# Standardize county names and merge
validation_df <- tbd_risk %>%
  mutate(County = tolower(stringr::str_replace_all(County, " ", ""))) %>%
  inner_join(
    tbd_inc %>%
      mutate(County = tolower(stringr::str_replace_all(County, " ", ""))),
    by = "County"
  )

cat("Counties in validation dataset:", nrow(validation_df), "\n")


# Ixodes scapularis NB regression
m_nb_is <- glm.nb(is_tbd_cases ~ Risk_is_scaled + offset(log(population)),
                  data = validation_df,
                  init.theta = 0.5, maxit = 100)

# Dermacentor variabilis NB regression
m_nb_dv <- glm.nb(dv_tbd_cases ~ Risk_dv_scaled + offset(log(population)),
                  data = validation_df,
                  init.theta = 0.5, maxit = 100)

# Amblyomma americanum NB regression
m_nb_aa <- glm.nb(aa_tbd_cases ~ Risk_aa_scaled + offset(log(population)),
                  data = validation_df,
                  init.theta = 0.5, maxit = 100)

# Forest plot data
# Order: AA top, DV middle, IS bottom to match scatter left to right
forest_df <- data.frame(
  Species = c("Amblyomma americanum",
              "Dermacentor variabilis",
              "Ixodes scapularis"),

  IRR = c(
    exp(coef(m_nb_aa)["Risk_aa_scaled"] * 0.2),
    exp(coef(m_nb_dv)["Risk_dv_scaled"] * 0.2),
    exp(coef(m_nb_is)["Risk_is_scaled"] * 0.2)
  ),

  lower = c(
    exp(confint(m_nb_aa)["Risk_aa_scaled", 1] * 0.2),
    exp(confint(m_nb_dv)["Risk_dv_scaled", 1] * 0.2),
    exp(confint(m_nb_is)["Risk_is_scaled", 1] * 0.2)
  ),

  upper = c(
    exp(confint(m_nb_aa)["Risk_aa_scaled", 2] * 0.2),
    exp(confint(m_nb_dv)["Risk_dv_scaled", 2] * 0.2),
    exp(confint(m_nb_is)["Risk_is_scaled", 2] * 0.2)
  ),

  p_val = c(
    coef(summary(m_nb_aa))["Risk_aa_scaled", "Pr(>|z|)"],
    coef(summary(m_nb_dv))["Risk_dv_scaled", "Pr(>|z|)"],
    coef(summary(m_nb_is))["Risk_is_scaled", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  )
)

forest_df <- forest_df %>%
  mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("Ixodes scapularis",
                                         "Dermacentor variabilis",
                                         "Amblyomma americanum")),
    sig_label = case_when(
      p_val < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
      p_val < 0.01  ~ paste0("p = ", round(p_val, 3)),
      TRUE          ~ paste0("p = ", round(p_val, 3))
    ),
    irr_label = paste0("IRR = ", round(IRR, 2),
                       " (", round(lower, 2), "-", round(upper, 2), ")")
  )

# Forest plot
p_forest <- ggplot(forest_df, aes(y = Species, x = IRR, color = Species)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
                 height = 0.15, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 18) +
  geom_text(aes(label = irr_label, x = upper),
            hjust = -0.08, size = 4.5, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label, x = lower),
            hjust = 1.08, size = 4, color = "black", fontface = "italic") +
 scale_color_manual(values = c(
 "Ixodes scapularis"      = "#264653",
 "Dermacentor variabilis" = "#2F6B5F",
 "Amblyomma americanum"   = "#8C3B3B"
)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c(
    "Ixodes scapularis"      = expression(italic("I. scapularis")),
    "Dermacentor variabilis" = expression(italic("D. variabilis")),
    "Amblyomma americanum"   = expression(italic("A. americanum"))
  )) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100),
    labels = c("0.1", "1", "10", "100"),
    limits = c(0.05, 100)
  )+
  labs(
    x     = "Incidence rate ratio",
    y     = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "none",
    axis.text          = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    axis.title         = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray92", linewidth = 0.4)
  )

print(p_forest)

# Scatter plot function with optional y-axis label and optional legend
scatter_nb <- function(data, risk_col, case_col, model, species_label, dot_color, show_legend = TRUE) {
  pred_df <- data.frame(
    risk       = seq(min(data[[risk_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                     max(data[[risk_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                     length.out = 200),
    population = mean(data$population)
  )
  names(pred_df)[1] <- risk_col
  pred_df$fitted <- predict(model,
                            newdata = pred_df,
                            type = "response") / mean(data$population) * 100000
  obs_df <- data %>%
    mutate(
      obs_inc = .data[[case_col]] / population * 100000,
      risk    = .data[[risk_col]]
    )
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = obs_df,
               aes(x = risk, y = obs_inc, size = population),
               fill = dot_color, color = "black", alpha = 0.55, shape = 21,
               stroke = 0.3,
               show.legend = show_legend) +
    geom_line(data = pred_df,
              aes(x = .data[[risk_col]], y = fitted),
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name   = "Population",
      range  = c(1, 6),
      labels = scales::comma,
      guide  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 0.6))
    )  +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    labs(
      title = bquote(italic(.(species_label))),
      x     = "Risk score",
      y     = if (species_label == "Amblyomma americanum") "Incidence per 100,000" else NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16,
                                     face = "italic", color = "black"),
      axis.text       = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
      axis.title      = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(margin = margin(r = 2)),
      plot.margin     = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 2),
      legend.title    = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

# AA left, DV middle, IS right with original species colors
p_aa <- scatter_nb(validation_df, "Risk_aa_scaled", "aa_tbd_cases",
                   m_nb_aa, "Amblyomma americanum", "#8C3B3B", show_legend = FALSE)
p_dv <- scatter_nb(validation_df, "Risk_dv_scaled", "dv_tbd_cases",
                   m_nb_dv, "Dermacentor variabilis", "#2F6B5F", show_legend = TRUE)
p_is <- scatter_nb(validation_df, "Risk_is_scaled", "is_tbd_cases",
                   m_nb_is, "Ixodes scapularis", "#264653", show_legend = FALSE)

# Combine scatter panels — only DV shows its own legend, now plain circles
combined_scatter_plot <- p_aa + p_dv + p_is +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3)

print(combined_scatter_plot)

out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Output"

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "validation_NB_forest_only.tiff"),
       p_forest, width = 10, height = 4.5, dpi = 300, device = "tiff")

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "validation_NB_scatter_plot.tiff"),
       combined_scatter_plot, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, device = "tiff")

```



## Plotting Negative Binomial Results (Without Oulier)
```{r}
library(MASS)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Import primary risk scores
tbd_risk <- read_csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/Vector-level risk/Vector_level_risk_scaled.csv"
)

# Import TBD incidence data
tbd_inc <- read_csv(
  "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Data/TBD cases/TBD_annual_average_incidence_scaled_vector.csv"
)

# Standardize county names and merge
validation_df <- tbd_risk %>%
  mutate(County = tolower(stringr::str_replace_all(County, " ", ""))) %>%
  inner_join(
    tbd_inc %>%
      mutate(County = tolower(stringr::str_replace_all(County, " ", ""))),
    by = "County"
  )

cat("Counties in validation dataset:", nrow(validation_df), "\n")


# Identify top outlier county per species by incidence rate
outlier_aa <- validation_df$County[which.max(validation_df$aa_tbd_cases / validation_df$population)]
outlier_dv <- validation_df$County[which.max(validation_df$dv_tbd_cases / validation_df$population)]
outlier_is <- validation_df$County[which.max(validation_df$is_tbd_cases / validation_df$population)]

cat("AA outlier:", outlier_aa, "\n")
cat("DV outlier:", outlier_dv, "\n")
cat("IS outlier:", outlier_is, "\n")

# Remove all identified outlier counties from validation dataset
outliers <- unique(c(outlier_aa, outlier_dv, outlier_is))
cat("Counties removed:", paste(outliers, collapse = ", "), "\n")

validation_df <- validation_df %>%
  dplyr::filter(!County %in% outliers)

cat("Counties remaining after outlier removal:", nrow(validation_df), "\n")

# Ixodes scapularis NB regression
m_nb_is <- glm.nb(is_tbd_cases ~ Risk_is_scaled + offset(log(population)),
                  data = validation_df,
                  init.theta = 0.5, maxit = 100)

# Dermacentor variabilis NB regression
m_nb_dv <- glm.nb(dv_tbd_cases ~ Risk_dv_scaled + offset(log(population)),
                  data = validation_df,
                  init.theta = 0.5, maxit = 100)

# Amblyomma americanum NB regression
m_nb_aa <- glm.nb(aa_tbd_cases ~ Risk_aa_scaled + offset(log(population)),
                  data = validation_df,
                  init.theta = 0.5, maxit = 100)

# Forest plot data
# Order: AA top, DV middle, IS bottom to match scatter left to right
forest_df <- data.frame(
  Species = c("Amblyomma americanum",
              "Dermacentor variabilis",
              "Ixodes scapularis"),

  IRR = c(
    exp(coef(m_nb_aa)["Risk_aa_scaled"] * 0.2),
    exp(coef(m_nb_dv)["Risk_dv_scaled"] * 0.2),
    exp(coef(m_nb_is)["Risk_is_scaled"] * 0.2)
  ),

  lower = c(
    exp(confint(m_nb_aa)["Risk_aa_scaled", 1] * 0.2),
    exp(confint(m_nb_dv)["Risk_dv_scaled", 1] * 0.2),
    exp(confint(m_nb_is)["Risk_is_scaled", 1] * 0.2)
  ),

  upper = c(
    exp(confint(m_nb_aa)["Risk_aa_scaled", 2] * 0.2),
    exp(confint(m_nb_dv)["Risk_dv_scaled", 2] * 0.2),
    exp(confint(m_nb_is)["Risk_is_scaled", 2] * 0.2)
  ),

  p_val = c(
    coef(summary(m_nb_aa))["Risk_aa_scaled", "Pr(>|z|)"],
    coef(summary(m_nb_dv))["Risk_dv_scaled", "Pr(>|z|)"],
    coef(summary(m_nb_is))["Risk_is_scaled", "Pr(>|z|)"]
  )
)

forest_df <- forest_df %>%
  mutate(
    Species = factor(Species, levels = c("Ixodes scapularis",
                                         "Dermacentor variabilis",
                                         "Amblyomma americanum")),
    sig_label = case_when(
      p_val < 0.001 ~ "p < 0.001",
      p_val < 0.01  ~ paste0("p = ", round(p_val, 3)),
      TRUE          ~ paste0("p = ", round(p_val, 3))
    ),
    irr_label = paste0("IRR = ", round(IRR, 2),
                       " (", round(lower, 2), "-", round(upper, 2), ")")
  )

# Forest plot
p_forest <- ggplot(forest_df, aes(y = Species, x = IRR, color = Species)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
                 height = 0.15, linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 4, shape = 18) +
  geom_text(aes(label = irr_label, x = upper),
            hjust = -0.08, size = 4.5, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label, x = lower),
            hjust = 1.08, size = 4, color = "black", fontface = "italic") +
 scale_color_manual(values = c(
 "Ixodes scapularis"      = "#264653",
 "Dermacentor variabilis" = "#2F6B5F",
 "Amblyomma americanum"   = "#8C3B3B"
)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c(
    "Ixodes scapularis"      = expression(italic("I. scapularis")),
    "Dermacentor variabilis" = expression(italic("D. variabilis")),
    "Amblyomma americanum"   = expression(italic("A. americanum"))
  )) +
  scale_x_log10(
    breaks = c(0.1, 1, 10, 100),
    labels = c("0.1", "1", "10", "100"),
    limits = c(0.05, 100)
  )+
  labs(
    x     = "Incidence rate ratio",
    y     = NULL
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "none",
    axis.text          = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    axis.title         = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
    plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "black"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "gray92", linewidth = 0.4)
  )

print(p_forest)

# Scatter plot function with optional y-axis label and optional legend
scatter_nb <- function(data, risk_col, case_col, model, species_label, dot_color, show_legend = TRUE) {
  pred_df <- data.frame(
    risk       = seq(min(data[[risk_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                     max(data[[risk_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
                     length.out = 200),
    population = mean(data$population)
  )
  names(pred_df)[1] <- risk_col
  pred_df$fitted <- predict(model,
                            newdata = pred_df,
                            type = "response") / mean(data$population) * 100000
  obs_df <- data %>%
    mutate(
      obs_inc = .data[[case_col]] / population * 100000,
      risk    = .data[[risk_col]]
    )
  ggplot() +
    geom_point(data = obs_df,
               aes(x = risk, y = obs_inc, size = population),
               fill = dot_color, color = "black", alpha = 0.55, shape = 21,
               stroke = 0.3,
               show.legend = show_legend) +
    geom_line(data = pred_df,
              aes(x = .data[[risk_col]], y = fitted),
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.9) +
    scale_size_continuous(
      name   = "Population",
      range  = c(1, 6),
      labels = scales::comma,
      guide  = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "white", color = "black", stroke = 0.6))
    )  +
    guides(fill = "none") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    labs(
      title = bquote(italic(.(species_label))),
      x     = "Risk score",
      y     = if (species_label == "Amblyomma americanum") "Incidence per 100,000" else NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16,
                                     face = "italic", color = "black"),
      axis.text       = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
      axis.title      = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
      axis.title.y    = element_text(margin = margin(r = 2)),
      plot.margin     = margin(t = 5, r = 5, b = 5, l = 2),
      legend.title    = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
      legend.text     = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}

# AA left, DV middle, IS right with original species colors
p_aa <- scatter_nb(validation_df, "Risk_aa_scaled", "aa_tbd_cases",
                   m_nb_aa, "Amblyomma americanum", "#8C3B3B", show_legend = FALSE)
p_dv <- scatter_nb(validation_df, "Risk_dv_scaled", "dv_tbd_cases",
                   m_nb_dv, "Dermacentor variabilis", "#2F6B5F", show_legend = TRUE)
p_is <- scatter_nb(validation_df, "Risk_is_scaled", "is_tbd_cases",
                   m_nb_is, "Ixodes scapularis", "#264653", show_legend = FALSE)

# Combine scatter panels — only DV shows its own legend, now plain circles
combined_scatter_plot <- p_aa + p_dv + p_is +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3)

print(combined_scatter_plot)

       combined_scatter_plot, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, device = "tiff")
```

## Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) analysis using the Area Under the Curve (AUC)
```{r}
library(pROC)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

# Dichotomize counties by disease presence (≥1 case vs 0 cases)
validation_df <- validation_df %>%
  mutate(
burden_is = ifelse(is_tbd_cases > 0, 1, 0),
burden_dv = ifelse(dv_tbd_cases > 0, 1, 0),
burden_aa = ifelse(aa_tbd_cases > 0, 1, 0)
  )

# ROC and AUC for each species
roc_is <- roc(validation_df$burden_is, validation_df$Risk_is_scaled)
roc_dv <- roc(validation_df$burden_dv, validation_df$Risk_dv_scaled)
roc_aa <- roc(validation_df$burden_aa, validation_df$Risk_aa_scaled)

cat("IS AUC:", auc(roc_is), "\n")
cat("DV AUC:", auc(roc_dv), "\n")
cat("AA AUC:", auc(roc_aa), "\n")

cat("IS AUC 95% CI:", ci.auc(roc_is), "\n")
cat("DV AUC 95% CI:", ci.auc(roc_dv), "\n")
cat("AA AUC 95% CI:", ci.auc(roc_aa), "\n")

# Build ROC curve dataframes for ggplot
roc_to_df <- function(roc_obj, species) {
  data.frame(
    FPR     = 1 - roc_obj$specificities,
    TPR     = roc_obj$sensitivities,
    Species = species
  )
}

roc_df <- bind_rows(
  roc_to_df(roc_aa, "Amblyomma americanum"),
  roc_to_df(roc_dv, "Dermacentor variabilis"),
  roc_to_df(roc_is, "Ixodes scapularis")
)

# AUC label dataframe
auc_labels <- data.frame(
  Species = c("Amblyomma americanum", "Dermacentor variabilis", "Ixodes scapularis"),
  AUC     = c(as.numeric(auc(roc_aa)),
              as.numeric(auc(roc_dv)),
              as.numeric(auc(roc_is))),
  CI_low  = c(ci.auc(roc_aa)[1], ci.auc(roc_dv)[1], ci.auc(roc_is)[1]),
  CI_high = c(ci.auc(roc_aa)[3], ci.auc(roc_dv)[3], ci.auc(roc_is)[3])
) %>%
  mutate(
    label = paste0("AUC = ", round(AUC, 3),
                   " (", round(CI_low, 3), "-", round(CI_high, 3), ")")
  )

# ROC plot function per species
plot_roc <- function(df, species_name, line_color, auc_df) {

  auc_label <- auc_df %>% filter(Species == species_name) %>% pull(label)

  df %>%
    filter(Species == species_name) %>%
    arrange(FPR) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = FPR, y = TPR)) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_line(color = line_color, linewidth = 1.1) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = TPR),
                fill = line_color, alpha = 0.12) +
    annotate("text",
            x = 0.05, y = 0.93,
             label = auc_label,
             size = 4, color = "black", hjust = 0) +
    labs(
      title = bquote(italic(.(species_name))),
      x     = "1 - Specificity (False Positive Rate)",
      y     = "Sensitivity (True Positive Rate)"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25)) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16,
                                 face = "italic", color = "black"),
      axis.text   = element_text(color = "black", size = 14),
      axis.title.x = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, face = "bold"),
  axis.title.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 14, face = "bold")
)
}

p_roc_aa <- plot_roc(roc_df, "Amblyomma americanum",   "#8C3B3B", auc_labels)
p_roc_dv <- plot_roc(roc_df, "Dermacentor variabilis", "#2F6B5F", auc_labels)
p_roc_is <- plot_roc(roc_df, "Ixodes scapularis",      "#264653", auc_labels)

# Combine panels AA left DV middle IS right
roc_panel <- p_roc_aa + p_roc_dv + p_roc_is +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3) 

print(roc_panel)

out_dir <- "C:/Users/abrar/OneDrive - University of Illinois - Urbana/Documents/Abrar Hussain/Ph.D/Ph.D. Papers/As Authors/TBD Risk Score Illinois/Output"

ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "validation_ROC.tiff"),
       roc_panel, width = 14, height = 5.5, dpi = 300, device = "tiff")

message("Saved: ROC_validation.tiff")
```
